lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: The headless branch ignores `implBackend`. With `[backend] implementer…

openQuestions: scripts/cam/prd.json may still carry a sixth round-1 finding, passes:false and untouched by this story, per AGENT.md 'Do not edit prd.json'. Whoever picks up the next US-R1-* story should confirm it still self-selects correctly.

This story fixed the fail-OPEN bug by failing CLOSED (block before dispatch) rather than rendering a real codex-native headless argv, because buildHeadlessChildInvocation/headless-dispatch.ts/headless-stream.ts are all built around claude's stream-json protocol specifically -- rendering codex's own headless argv would require an entirely separate completion-detection protocol, out of surgical scope for this WARNING-class fix. If codex-backed headless dispatch becomes a real product requirement, that is a new epic, not a follow-up to this story.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-005 fixed the headless dispatch branch (src/supervisor/loop.ts, the `if (opts.headless === true)` block) ignoring implBackend: with `[backend] implementer = "codex"` in project.toml plus `--headless`, the loop used to silently dispatch `claude` (headless-argv.ts:74 hardcodes argv[0] = 'claude', and the whole headless stack -- headless-dispatch.ts, headless-stream.ts -- speaks claude's stream-json protocol specifically), contradicting the configured backend, with no emitSpawnResolution event recorded either (for ANY backend, including claude). Fixed both halves: (1) added a fail-closed check `if (implBackend !== 'claude')` immediately before the headlessDispatchFn-undefined throw, blocking with a `headless-backend-unsupported: ... (advisory ...)` detail naming both 'headless' and the resolved backend, mirroring the existing US-006 headless+container fail-closed shape (same lastOutcome/finishTerminal('blocked')/return shape) rather than inventing a new terminal shape; (2) added an `emitSpawnResolution({ phase: 'implementer', model: implModel, backend: implBackend, writeEvent: ... })` call in the headless branch, placed after the existing container check and before the new backend check, mirroring where the tmux branch emits its own spawn-resolution event relative to its backend-specific gate (codexAuthPreflight) -- so the audit event fires even when the backend check then blocks the dispatch, exactly like the tmux branch's container-preflight-vs-codex-auth-preflight asymmetry. New test file test/supervisor/headless-backend-failclose.test.ts (4 tests) pins: blocks-before-dispatch with detail naming 'headless'+'codex', spawn-resolution event still recorded on the blocked path, claude backend still dispatches normally, and claude backend also now emits a spawn-resolution event on the success path (previously it emitted none, for any backend -- this is a small but real behavior change for the claude+headless success path too, not just the codex+headless block path). Root-cause scope decision: did NOT attempt to render a real codex-native headless argv (a second, entirely different completion-detection protocol) -- fail-closed is the surgical, in-scope fix for this WARNING; a real codex-headless implementation is a new epic if ever needed (see openQuestions). Raised src/supervisor/loop.ts's file-size ceiling 2956->3008 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (with a dated _ref note naming this story) for the added guard + comments. Step 5.5: no new external library touched (lib=none) -- this reuses the existing emitSpawnResolution/readPhaseBackend/selectAdapter seams already validated by prior US-R1-00x stories in this same round.
